correctness.rationale: Radiality kills the off-diagonal moments in the complete normalized monomial basis. Under normalized weighted area, the substitution x=|z|² gives the eigenvalue beta-moment ratio, hence the exact gamma quotient. For fixed α,t the gamma ratio gives n^(-it)(1+O(n^-1)); the attenuation constant can also be checked directly by y=n(1-x), dominated convergence using (1-y/n)^n≤e^-y, and normalized gamma moments. Γ has no zeros in the stated range, and reflection and recurrence give the unweighted magnitude. Continuous positive logarithmic phase-time has every tail dense in the two-torus for irrational β/γ; for a rational ratio each tail contains the whole periodic orbit. Approximating the continuous times s_j→∞ by log of integers nearest e^s_j preserves phase limits. Thus the diagonal tail-cluster set is exactly the corresponding continuous image. Independent rotations and the relative-angle formula realize the whole irrational annulus, including the origin when a=b. In the rational case p≠q makes the relative phase sweep the circle, so both extremal moduli are still attained, although the compact analytic curve has planar area zero by bounded speed. Outside the cluster set the diagonal tail is boundedly invertible; within it weakly null coordinate vectors show failure of Fredholmness. Finite truncations give the upper bound for the essential norm, and compact operators send the normalized coordinate sequence to zero in norm, giving the limsup lower bound. The diagonal kernel and adjoint kernel have the same dimension when Fredholm, so the index is zero.
residual_risks: All asymptotics are for fixed parameters, with no uniform quantifier near α=-1, large frequencies, or rational ratios of growing denominator. Isolated finite-index eigenvalues need not belong to the essential spectrum.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge pass only for the explicit two-tone power-weight Bergman family with its exact gamma attenuation and arithmetic transition. Earlier general realization of connected compact essential spectra and existence of radial bounded-symbol examples with nonempty interior are not claimed as new. The closest inspected local results are either about other observables or other symbol classes. The exact contents of Grudsky–Vasilevski's closely related examples remain a concrete priority risk, not contrary evidence or a scientific blocker.
residual_risks: The full 2001 Grudsky–Vasilevski paper was not available; its examples could contain the explicit logarithmic-symbol case or a theorem implying it. The review is not a claim of exhaustive priority, or of novelty of two-dimensional essential spectra by themselves.

value.rationale: The natural question is what essential geometry an elementary combination of two boundary oscillations generates, not whether a general closure class can generate a prescribed set. This family gives explicit attenuation, a Fredholm threshold, and a sharp change from zero area to a solid annulus controlled by arithmetic alone. That is a useful exact classification for actual bounded radial symbols despite the prior general realization theorem.
residual_risks: Value is attached to the symbol-level classification, not to a new general existence, compactness, or Fredholm theorem for radial Toeplitz operators.
